verdict.rationale: Rive documents event-driven behavior inside its own content. Experiences respond to user input, scrolling and application state, data changes update scenes automatically, and state machines and scripting add custom interactions. That amounts to rules triggering actions, but only within the animation runtime, not as general workflow automation. missing for 10: an explicit rule/trigger authoring surface (conditions, listeners, events) documented in depth, automation of product or workflow events beyond scene playback, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Build interactive experiences that respond to user input, screen size, scrolling, and application state.
When data changes, your scene updates automatically.
Use scripting to create custom interactions, procedural animation, and behaviors that go beyond the built-in tools.
